annotations.text:
Palette and metrics are real libadwaita dark values, not invented ones.
Window #242424 / chrome #303030 / cards 8% white / accent #3584e4.
Cards 12px, buttons and entries 6px, header bar 47px.

Service names come from your services.txt. Statuses, recipients
and log lines are sample data for the mockup - the log lines do
use the real format that log_change() writes.

No fake window buttons: this runs in a browser at 127.0.0.1:8080,
so a painted minimise/maximise/close strip would sit doubled up
under the real browser chrome.

This sheet is the porting target - every value here maps to a rule
in the CSS string in monitor_web.py.
